repos_data.description: Drive Unreal Engine 5.7 from any MCP client — 143 editor-automation tools (inspect, author, render) over a local TCP socket.

MCP server for Unreal Engine 5, built into the editor. AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex create and edit Blueprints, materials, levels, Niagara, animation, UMG, PCG, Sequencer, GAS and Behavior Trees, with every change checked and read back.
